：来世为你当牛做马（：来世为你当牛做马（第22页）那些人，无一不是在她面前装成一副正人君子的模样，但眼神中的贪婪，却恨不得将她给生吞活剥一样。反观江澜，虽然嘴上花花了点，但眼神却一直很清澈纯粹。所以……“圣女大人，你身子的事儿我们待会儿再说，你先告诉我，那两个孩子，叫什么？”沈清寒没想到江澜话题转移的这么快，不过还是回应道：“大的叫许梨，小的叫许满。”她继续道：“老账房姓许，原本是江南一个县衙账房，后来当地官吏克扣赈灾粮，他不肯改账，便被人打断了腿。”又是一个可怜人。不过话说回来，生逢乱世，谁又不可怜呢？“那两个孩子，有什么特征吗？”沈清寒想了想。“阿梨左手腕上，有一根红绳。”江澜脑海里立刻浮现出那大些的小姑娘。她当时紧紧抱着妹妹，手腕上确实有一点暗红。只不过夜色太暗，他没看清是什么。“还有呢？”“小满不爱说话。”“这算特征？”“她……”沈清寒沉默一瞬，“她之前很爱说话……”“啧……”环境是会改变人的。至于什么样的环境，才能让一个之前活泼开朗的女孩变成这样，那就得问这世道了。“等我消息吧。”沈清寒抬起头看向江澜，诧异道：“你要去找人？”“不然呢？”“现在就去？”“不然呢？”沈清寒皱眉。“你才刚回来。”“哇，你要是不说的话，我都不知道，我才刚回来呀。”沈清寒：“……”“王虎那边虽答应拖延，但你若再离开，被发现后，他未必还会替你遮掩。”江澜呲牙一笑：“他不遮掩，我就让他永远都不用遮掩了。”沈清寒：“……”江澜拍了拍衣摆。“况且，人家都能查到你的住处，你确定，就查不到那账房，和那两个小女孩儿身上？”沈清寒再次沉默。她当然知道。但……“若她们真的活着，我想求你帮我照顾一下她们。”“我自己都照顾不了呢，哪儿有照顾别人的能耐。”沈清寒有些失望。但江澜紧接着便道：“不过既然圣女大人都发话了，我要是不做，也不太合适。”沈清寒双眸亮起，一脸惊喜道：“真的？”“当然，所以你是不是也应该报答我一下？”“你想要什么报答？”江澜手指在下巴上来回摩挲一阵，又上下打量了沈清寒半天。“不如，你以身相许？”沈清寒当即羞红了脸。“登徒子！”忿忿说完，她声音却又低了下去。“我只残躯苟活于世，说不定几日后就死了，若有来世……我为你当牛做马。”“诶诶诶诶！”江澜连忙抬手，“当牛做马不用来世，现在也不是不行啊，吃草嘛。”“啊？让我吃草吗？什么意思？”“没事，到时候你就知道了。”

: I will be a cow or a horse for you in the next life (: I will be a cow or a horse for you in the next life (p. 22)) Those people all pretended to be gentlemen in front of her, but the greed in their eyes made them want to eat her alive. On the other hand, Jiang Lan, although her mouth was a bit fancy, her eyes were always clear and pure. So... "Ms. Saint, we will talk about your body later, you go first. Tell me, what are the names of those two children?" Shen Qinghan didn't expect Jiang Lan to change the subject so quickly, but he still responded: "The older one's name is Xu Li, and the younger one's name is Xu Man." She continued: "The old accountant's surname was Xu, and he was originally a county accountant in Jiangnan. Later, the local officials withheld the grain for disaster relief, so he had his legs broken. "But again, he was born in chaos. Who is not pitiful? "What are the characteristics of those two children?" Shen Qinghan thought for a while. "There is a red rope on Ah Li's left wrist." Jiang Lan immediately thought of the older girl. She was holding her sister tightly, and there was indeed a bit of dark red on her wrist. "What else?" "Xiao Man doesn't like to talk." "Is this a characteristic?" "She..." Shen Qinghan was silent for a moment, "She was very talkative before..." "Tsk..." Environment can change people. As for what kind of environment can make a lively and cheerful girl become like this, you have to ask the world. "Wait for my news." Shen Qinghan raised his head and looked at Jiang Lan, surprised: "You want to find someone?" "Otherwise?" "Go now?" "Otherwise. ?" Shen Qinghan frowned. "You just came back." "Wow, if you didn't tell me, I wouldn't have known. I just came back." "..." "Wang Hu promised to delay. If you leave again, he may not cover up for you after being discovered." Jiang Lan grinned: "If he doesn't cover up, I will let him never have to cover up." Shen Qinghan: "..." Jiang Lan patted him. "Besides, people can find out where you live. Are you sure that they can't find out about the accountant or the two little girls?" Shen Qinghan was silent again. Of course she knew, but... "If they are really alive, I want you to help me take care of them." "I can't take care of others myself." But Jiang Lan said a little disappointed. But since the Holy Lady has spoken, it would be inappropriate for me not to do it." Shen Qinghan's eyes lit up and he said with surprise. "Of course, so you should repay me?" "What do you want in return?" Jiang Lan rubbed his fingers up and down his chin for a while. "Why don't you agree with me?" Shen Qinghan blushed immediately. "Young disciple!" After she finished speaking angrily, her voice dropped again. "I'm just living in this world with only a broken body. I might die in a few days. If there is an afterlife... I'll work like a horse for you." "Hey, hey, hey, hey. !" Jiang Lan quickly raised his hand, "It's not okay to be a cow in the next life. You can eat grass." "What do you mean?" "It's okay. You'll know when the time comes."
